items.markdown:
Koh Samui has a warm tropical climate year-round with `average temperatures of 28°C to 33°C (82°F to 91°F)` , split into a dry season, a hot season, and a heavy monsoon period.[](https://www.kuoni.co.uk/destinations/south-east-asia/thailand/koh-samui/best-time-to-visit/) [[1]](https://www.kuoni.co.uk/destinations/south-east-asia/thailand/koh-samui/best-time-to-visit/)[[2]](https://www.traveloka.com/en-sg/explore/guides/koh-samui-weather-temperature-forecast/1002903)[[3]](https://www.trailfinders.com/blogs/best-time-to-visit-koh-samui)

Dry Season (January to April)

- **January** : Warm and pleasant with daytime highs around 30°C (86°F), occasional cooling breezes, and the tail-end of brief showers.
- **February** : One of the driest and sunniest months with calm seas and temperatures averaging 25°C to 31°C (77°F to 88°F).
- **March** : Very dry, sunny, and clear, with temperatures starting to climb up to 32°C (90°F).
- **April** : Hot, humid, and sunny with peaks reaching 33°C (91°F) and warm sea temperatures averaging 28°C (82°F).[](https://www.holiday-weather.com/ko_samui/averages/) [[1]](https://www.holiday-weather.com/ko_samui/averages/)[[2]](https://phanganist.com/koh-samui/koh-samui-weather-guide-best-seasons-climate)[[3]](https://kohtour.com/the-ultimate-guide-to-koh-samui-weather/)[[4]](https://www.firstchoice.co.uk/holidays/weather/asia/thailand/thailand/koh-samui.html)[[5]](https://weather-and-climate.com/average-monthly-Rainfall-Temperature-Sunshine,Ko+Samui-th,Thailand)

Hot and Transition Season (May to August)

- **May** : Very hot with average highs of 32°C (90°F) and the warmest water temperatures, shifting into sporadic short tropical showers.
- **June & July** : Hot and humid with daily maximums hitting 33°C (91°F) interspersed with brief, passing afternoon rain showers.
- **August** : Warm and humid with manageable rainfall and mostly normal island activities.[](https://www.holiday-weather.com/ko_samui/averages/) [[1]](https://weatherspark.com/y/112991/Average-Weather-in-Ko-Samui-Thailand-Year-Round)

Monsoon and Rainy Season (September to December)

- **September** : Unpredictable transition month with increasing rain showers, though still offering decent dry intervals.
- **October** : Rain picks up significantly as the monsoon approaches, with average highs around 31°C (87°F) and frequent heavy downpours.
- **November** : The wettest month of the year with heavy storms, rough seas, and peak monthly rainfall.
- **December** : High rainfall early in the month that gradually clears up by late December as drier conditions return.[](https://www.holiday-weather.com/ko_samui/averages/) [[1]](https://www.accuweather.com/en/th/ko-samui/5470/october-weather/5470)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DOAgC-Tiu8K/?hl=en)[[3]](https://www.timeanddate.com/weather/@1154689/climate)
